# The plain `deployment.env` lines `harness.render._render_env` may emit: the keys a human has judged to hold
# a name, a path, a port, an address or a choice, and never a credential (PL14, D216).
#
# **Who may add to this file: a human, who has read what the new render line holds and judged the key plain.**
# Not the builder of the change that adds the render line, on that builder's word alone; the owner (or
# whoever he names) reads the line and the value the render writes for it, then adds the key here in the same
# change. `scripts/refresh.py` adds a missing line to a deployment only from what `_render_env` emits, and
# `tests/harness/test_refresh_plain_lines.py` fails closed when a key the render emits is not on this list or
# matches the secret name test (`_SECRET_KEY` in `harness/apply.py`). A key that holds a secret is never
# added here: it belongs in `harness.apply`'s minted lines, which refresh never touches.
#
# One key per line; a line that starts with `#` and a blank line are comments.
# First list, 23 November 2026: every key the render emits for the five shapes (local-lite, small, cluster,
# cloud-platform, cloud-platform-poc) under both brands and each setting that adds a line (ClickHouse,
# OpenSearch, mail, organisation sign-in, connectors, grading file, hosted fallback, engines, reporting,
# the worker, Laurium, resources, a graph port). Written by the builder of PL14a; to be read by the owner.
